observations: Two photos show a large black solar panel (mono-style) standing outdoors/warehouse floor.
The panel has a grid of cells and a visible frame; no clear wattage label is readable in the provided images.
A watermark/text overlay appears on the photos (e.g., '...GLOBAL GROUP'), but the actual manufacturer/model/wattage sticker is not clearly readable.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show only a solar panel, and no inverter/battery/charge unit is shown.

risks.risk: Wattage rating is not readable; price depends heavily on whether it’s ~300W, 350W, 400W, etc.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing brand, model, and rated wattage (W), plus serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest matching comparable assumption (worst case) until the wattage label is shown.

risks.risk: Condition/usage status (new vs used) and any damage (micro-cracks, delamination, bent frame) can’t be confirmed from these wide shots.
risks.proof: Clear close-ups of the front glass and frame corners + backsheet/back view (if available) showing no cracks/burn marks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition (worst case) until damage/condition is proven.

risks.risk: Electrical performance (whether it still produces rated power) is not testable from photos.
risks.proof: A working test: IV curve or at least a multimeter/solar tester reading under sun, showing voltage/current at a stated irradiance.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to meet rated output (worst case) until a test is provided.

risks.risk: Brand/model (e.g., Canadian Solar, Longi, Jinko, Suntex) is not readable; comparables vary by brand and wattage.
risks.proof: Close-up of the manufacturer logo and the full spec label (brand + model).
risks.if_unproven: Price using the cheapest comparable for the visible generic mono panel until brand/model is confirmed.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the panel specification label/sticker (brand, model, rated wattage in W, voltage/current, serial number).
Front glass close-ups (corners and any hairline cracks) and frame close-ups.
Back view close-up (junction box area and any burn marks/damage).
Photo/video of a performance test (IV/solar tester reading) or a simple measured output under sun.
response.reason: The photos show a solar panel, but the key pricing driver (rated wattage/brand/model from the label) is not readable, so a worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently from the comparables.
